propositions: max_consecutive_repeat metric is blind to cycles with length >= 2 because it only detects adjacent identical signatures, causing a genuine 4-call cycle to score 1 while healthy breadth-first runs score higher

the proposed windowed distinct-ratio signal (trailing 24 calls, set cardinality / window size, trip threshold <= 0.50) catches all cycle lengths and maintains wide separation from healthy runs without false positives on short sequences

the repetition detector must report distinct_ratio_window as an additive field alongside existing counters, with named constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 shared across three consumers
the field must return None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false trips on short all-identical prefixes like (2 calls, 2 distinct) scoring 0.5
code refactor splits usage_log.py into two modules (usage_log.py 572 LOC, usage_report.py 313 LOC) to stay under the 800 LOC hard cap, with lazy forwarding preserving CLI and import compatibility
